Class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
repository.AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendshipFileRepository, UserFileRepository
public abstract class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Adds validated UTF-8 text persistence to an in-memory repository. Subclasses define the line format and invoke loadFromFile() after initialization. Reads use the memory snapshot rather than rereading the file. Successful mutations rewrite the whole file in unspecified entity order. A write can truncate or partially replace the file before failing; there is no disk rollback or atomic replacement.

    • loadFromFile

      protected final void loadFromFile()
      Adds entities from the configured UTF-8 file to the current memory contents. A missing file leaves memory unchanged and is not created. Blank lines are ignored. Parsing, validation and duplicate-ID failures of type IllegalArgumentException, ValidationException or DateTimeParseException are reported to standard error and skipped; subsequent lines are still read. The file is never rewritten during loading. Other unchecked failures propagate. An I/O failure may leave previously loaded entities in memory.
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if opening, reading or closing the file fails

    • save

      public void save(E entity)
      Validates the entity, inserts it in memory, then rewrites the file. Validation and duplicate checks occur before any write. If writing throws RepositoryException, the inserted mapping is removed from memory; file contents and created directories are not restored. Other unchecked failures are propagated without this memory restoration.
      Specified by:
      save in interface Repository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Overrides:
      save in class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity accepted by the validator, with a non-null unique ID
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if validation rejects the entity
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity or ID is null after validation, or the identifier is already stored
      RepositoryException - if rewriting the file fails

    • delete

      public void delete(ID id)
      Removes a stored entity from memory and rewrites the file without revalidating it. If writing throws RepositoryException, the original object reference is reinserted in memory. File contents are not restored; other unchecked failures do not trigger this memory restoration.
      Specified by:
      delete in interface Repository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Overrides:
      delete in class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Parameters:
      id - the existing identifier to remove
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is null or not stored
      RepositoryException - if rewriting the file fails

    • update

      public void update(E entity)
      Validates a replacement before checking its existence, then updates memory and rewrites the file. If writing throws RepositoryException, the original object reference is restored in memory. File contents are not restored; other unchecked failures do not trigger this memory restoration.
      Specified by:
      update in interface Repository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Overrides:
      update in class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
      Parameters:
      entity - the replacement accepted by the validator, with an existing ID
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if validation rejects the replacement
      IllegalArgumentException - if its ID is absent, or memory argument checks fail
      NullPointerException - if the validator accepts a null replacement
      RepositoryException - if rewriting the file fails
